title: Wavenumber-Aware Deep Learning for Robust Analysis of Raman Spectra
abstract: arXiv:2610.30746v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine-learning models for spectroscopy usually treat a spectrum as a fixed-grid intensity vector, leaving the physical coordinate implicit in the array index. Such models are tied to a single sampling grid, spectral range and resolution, which limits their use when measurement conditions change. Here we represent each spectral point as a pair of intensity and wavenumber and compute Transformer positional encodings from the wavenumber itself. On Raman spectra of three bacterial species and their synthetic mixtures, this representation remained robust to noise, sparser sampling and partial spectral coverage across convolutional, residual and Transformer networks. In controlled comparisons, wavenumber-based encoding outperformed index-based and learned encodings under partial observation and retained its performance on sampling grids never seen during training, where index-based encoding degraded. translated_title: 面向拉曼光谱稳健分析的波数感知深度学习
translated_abstract: 用于光谱学的机器学习模型通常将光谱视为固定网格上的强度向量，物理坐标被隐含地编码在数组索引中。这类模型因此与单一的采样网格、光谱范围和分辨率绑定，限制了其在测量条件变化时的应用。本文将每个光谱点表示为强度与波数的配对，并直接从波数本身计算Transformer的位置编码。在三种细菌及其人工混合物的拉曼光谱上，这种表示方法在卷积网络、残差网络和Transformer网络中均表现出对噪声、稀疏采样和部分光谱覆盖的稳健性。在受控对比实验中，基于波数的编码在部分观测条件下优于基于索引的编码和可学习的编码，并且在训练中从未见过的采样网格上仍保持了性能，而基于索引的编码则出现性能下降。这些发现在公开数据集上得到了复现。
tldr: 本文提出将光谱点表示为强度-波数对并从波数本身计算Transformer位置编码，使深度学习模型在噪声、稀疏采样、部分光谱覆盖以及未见过的采样网格条件下均能稳健地分析拉曼光谱。
en_tdlr: By representing each spectral point as an intensity-wavenumber pair and computing Transformer positional encodings from the wavenumber itself, this work enables deep learning models to robustly analyze Raman spectra under noise, sparse sampling, partial spectral coverage, and unseen sampling grids.
